title.zh: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale

current_state.zh: Anthropic research contends that LLMs make formal software verification practical at far larger scale, and Hacker News commenters describe using models to generate Lean proofs for real codebases and Alloy models for security verification.
